UPDATE F_BUDGET_LINE
SET amount_used = amount_used + $2, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1 AND deleted = 0

`

	ID         int64          `json:"id"`

func (q *Queries) DeductLineForOutward(ctx context.Context, arg DeductLineForOutwardParams) (int64, error) {
